_about: Nitrogen (1) + methanol (2): mole fraction solubility of nitrogen at a nitrogen partial pressure of 1 atm, 213.15-298.15 K, from Katayama and Nitta (1976), as compiled in IUPAC SDS Vol. 10.

source.citation: T. Katayama, T. Nitta, Solubilities of hydrogen and nitrogen in alcohols and n-hexane, J. Chem. Eng. Data 21 (1976) 194-196
source.access: The original article is not open; its values are compiled in IUPAC Solubility Data Series Vol. 10, Nitrogen and Air (R. Battino, ed., Pergamon, 1982; copyright IUPAC), which IUPAC publishes as open access at iupac.github.io
source.tables: IUPAC Solubility Data Series Vol. 10 (1982) p 182 (PDF p 227), prepared by C. L. Young; the column 'mole fraction of nitrogen in liquid, at a partial pressure of 1 atmosphere' (the Ostwald coefficients and Henry's constants of the same table are not used). Volumetric apparatus; estimated error T 0.12 K at 213.15 K, 0.05 K at the others, x 1 % (U_x_1).
source.transcription: Read from the scanned page image (rendered at 110 dpi) and the PDF's text layer, which agree value by value. The person checking should compare each row with the page.

notes: x_1 is the mole fraction of nitrogen in the liquid at a partial pressure of nitrogen of 101.325 kPa (1 atm), as the compiler gives it; it is stored as p_1_kPa = 101.325 (the fit compares it with y_1 P of the bubble point at x_1). To be checked by a person against the page (AGENTS.md rule 4).
